annotations.title: TIA — master copy from a device

description: Creates a master copy of a DEVICE (station) in the open project's library and returns its name. Only a device is accepted as the source — a PLC block cannot become a master copy through this route. Maps to POST /library/mastercopies {device}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

device.description: device (station) name, as listed by tia_devices

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project
